steps.title: HTML & CSS
steps.subtitle: Structure and style the web
steps.description: Write semantic, accessible HTML and lay it out with modern CSS: the box model, Flexbox, Grid and media queries. Every framework renders down to this, and interviewers expect you to build a responsive page from scratch.

topics.name: Semantic HTML5 elements and page structure (header, nav, main, section, footer)
Forms, input types, labels and accessibility basics (alt text, ARIA, keyboard focus)
CSS selectors, specificity and the cascade
Box model, box-sizing, display and positioning (relative, absolute, fixed, sticky)
Flexbox and CSS Grid layouts
Responsive design: media queries, mobile-first and relative units (rem, %, vw)
CSS variables, transitions and a utility framework (Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap)

steps.title: JavaScript
steps.subtitle: Make pages interactive
steps.description: Learn the language of the web: types, functions and closures, array methods, the DOM and asynchronous code with promises and async/await. These fundamentals power React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend.

topics.name: Variables (let, const, var), data types, equality and type coercion
Functions, arrow functions, scope, hoisting and closures
Arrays and objects: map, filter, reduce, destructuring and spread
DOM manipulation and events (bubbling, delegation, preventDefault)
Asynchronous JavaScript: callbacks, promises and async/await with error handling
The event loop: call stack, microtasks and macrotasks
Fetch API, JSON and ES modules (import/export)

steps.title: React
steps.subtitle: Build component-driven UIs
steps.description: Build single-page apps from reusable components using state, hooks, effects, context and client-side routing. React is the most requested frontend skill in full stack job descriptions.

topics.name: Components, JSX and props
State with useState and event handling
Rendering lists with keys and conditional rendering
Controlled forms and lifting state up
useEffect: data fetching, dependency arrays and cleanup
useRef, useMemo, useCallback, React.memo and custom hooks
Context API and client-side routing with React Router

steps.title: Backend: Node.js, Express & Databases
steps.subtitle: Build APIs and persist data
steps.description: Design REST APIs with Node.js and Express, model data in SQL and NoSQL databases, and secure endpoints with hashed passwords and JWT or session auth. This turns your frontend into a complete full stack application.

topics.name: Node.js runtime, npm packages and project setup
REST API design: resources, HTTP methods, status codes and idempotency
Express routing, middleware, input validation and error handling
SQL: CRUD queries, JOINs, GROUP BY and transactions (ACID)
Schema design: normalization, SQL vs NoSQL (MongoDB), embedding vs referencing
Indexes, query performance and the N+1 problem
Authentication and authorization: password hashing (bcrypt), JWT and sessions

steps.title: Git, Deployment & Production
steps.subtitle: Ship, secure and run your app
steps.description: Collaborate with Git and GitHub, containerize with Docker, automate tests and deploys with CI/CD, and harden your app with HTTPS, CORS and security headers. A live, monitored project is what sets a placement-ready candidate apart.

topics.name: Git basics: commit, branch, merge, revert and resolving conflicts
GitHub workflow: pull requests, code review and .gitignore
Environment variables, configuration and secrets management
Docker basics: Dockerfile, images, containers and Docker Compose
CI/CD with GitHub Actions and hosting on Vercel, Netlify, Render or AWS
Web security: HTTPS, CORS, security headers, XSS, CSRF and SQL injection
Performance, HTTP caching, logging and monitoring basics
